properties.description:
Own repository/worktree status, commits, history, LFS and repository composition in the Git contributor without Harness sessions. Merge RepoCompose capabilities, update package consumers, and preserve caller-owned buildspace policy. Provide selected-file commits that preserve unrelated staged and unstaged changes.

Implemented in c53b05fd. Git operations and repository composition are owned by @super-app/git-contributor; configured-root operations no longer need an agent session. Selected-file commits preserve unrelated staged and unstaged code and use native Git filters (including configured LFS). Buildspace membership policy stays with its consumer. Verification: 29 composition scenarios, package/consumer regressions, generated model rebuild, organization check and full type-safety check (0 violations).
properties.title: Consolidate Git operations and RepoCompose
